name: pizza-delivery-backend
description: Pizza Delivery REST API — Node.js, Express, MongoDB

scripts.seed:all: node seedAdmin.js && node seedMenu.js && node seedInventory.js
scripts.test:razorpay-keys: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const k=process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID; const s=process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET; const w=process.env.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET; if(!k||!s||!w){console.error('❌ Missing Razorpay env vars');process.exit(1)} if(!k.startsWith('rzp_test_')){console.error('❌ RAZORPAY_KEY_ID must start with rzp_test_ — never use live keys');process.exit(1)} const R=require('razorpay'); const rzp=new R({key_id:k,key_secret:s}); rzp.orders.create({amount:100,currency:'INR',receipt:'test'}).then(o=>console.log('✅ Razorpay test-mode OK — order id:',o.id)).catch(e=>console.error('❌ Razorpay error:',e.message))"
